lines.en: : Well, well, well...Would you look who we have here?
: Am I being mugged?
I run into the Kanda sisters on my way home from[school], who are about to shake me down for all I am worth if we’re basing the rest of this event on Kirin’s first line of dialogue.
: Yes. Give us all of your money.
: We need to buy cigarettes and guns and other stuff that we’re definitely into despite our outwardly adorable appearances.
: I see.
: Karin, are you in on this too?
: ...Karin?
: Talking is hard.
: I’m just going to stand here and let Kirin take your money.
: I will buy lunch from the convenience store and eat all by myself, letting the snow pile up over my body and carry me off to a new life.
: Wait, you don’t actually need money, do you? Because I’m not giving you any.
: Uhh...no.
: How come everyone else is able to come up to you after[school] but the second I do it, you think you’re being mugged?
: How would I even mug you? Have you seen me? I’m like a third of your size.
: To be honest, I feel a lot safer knowing it’s just you against me now. Karin was the one I was worried about.
: Why are you worried about her and not me?!
: Why are you worried about me to begin with?! What did I do wrong?!
: Relax, soccer sisters. No one is fighting anyone today.
: ...What did you just call us?
: Soccer sisters...
: I love it.
: I personally prefer that the people I’m talking to use my actual name, but it’s whatever, I guess.
: What are you up to? Going home early?
: Early? I’m going home at the same time I always do.
: Really? Don’t you normally sit in your fancy office chair after[school] and wait for girls to show up and “talk?”
: If the nurse can take Fridays off, so can I.
: Oh, right. I forgot the first year teachers also acted as counselors.
: Is that not how it works for your grade?
: We just have one counselor who handles all of the classes.
: Probably because everyone has already resigned themselves to how much [high_school] sucks by the second year and is tired of complaining about it.
: But vulnerable, impressionable girls like myself rely on our teachers to make us feel better about the things that ail us. Right, Sensei?
: Yes, but in an incredibly roundabout way.
: You’ve...been seeing a guidance counselor?
: Kirin, I don’t know if you’re joking, but-
: So, Sensei, have you heard the news?
: News? What news?
: A certain “soccer sister” might be changing classes soon.
: What? You’re not in Ms. Watabe’s class, are you?
: I was at the beginning of the year but she axed me like, right off the bat.
: So they moved me to class C, but I’ve been really obnoxious in there because that teacher sucks even more.
: So, by process of elimination, I’ve got a preeeeetty good chance of ending up with you next.
: Unless they just decide to expel me instead. But a mind is a terrible thing to waste and blah blah blah adult-speak.
: Is there an open seat next to Ayane, by any chance?
: Hold on a second. I can’t tell if you’re actually being serious right now.
: You need me to spell it out for you?
: I, Kirin Kanda, have been intentionally provoking teachers to try and wind up in your class since the first time I heard Miku talk about you.
: Couldn’t you have just...asked for a transfer?
: A - There is literally zero fun in that.
: B - If a girl just asks to be transferred into the hot teacher’s class, literally everyone will start to think “you know what” is going on.
: Who knows what? I don’t follow.
: I’m saying that people are going to think I want to fuck him.
: Kirin!
: Just because he’s also our coach doesn’t mean you can say such vulgar things in front of him!
: Why not? He doesn’t care at all. Right, Sensei?
: It’s true. I really don’t.
: Of course he doesn’t care. It’s not his reputation at stake if someone hears that.
: Okay, I know people around here don’t exactly think too highly of me, but something like that would definitely still have some effect on my reputation.
: Oooooh, okay...Okay. You just don’t want somebody to hear me saying anything inappropriate because it will make you look bad. Gotcha.
: I’m worried about what people will think of you. I don’t care what anyone has to say about me.
: Easy for you to say when-
: Ugh...Just forget about it.
: Anyway, Sensei, point is that you shouldn’t be surprised if I suddenly wind up switching classes again.
: I’ll do my best to be a model student so I don’t embarrass you the same way I embarrass my older sister.
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
: Your face is really red all of a sudden.
: It is not.
: Do you two fight like this often?
: No. This is the first time ever.
: Is that sarcasm?
: Of course it’s fucking sarcasm. Why are we even talking about this right now?
: You should be celebrating that I jumped through so many hoops for the chance to study under you.
: Doesn’t it sound fun to have one more girl under you, Sensei?
: I’m leaving now.
: Are you coming home tonight or do I have to tell Mom to wrap your food in advance so you can eat whenever you decide to show up instead?
: The latter, please. I had plans with some friends tonight anyway.
: I’m sure you did.
Karin redirects her gaze from the ground to me and stares into my eyes for significantly longer than she ever has before.
Normally, this would be the part where she blushes and runs away.
Or collapses.
Or anything equally...Karin-ish.
But instead, she just looks at me.
Speaking nothing.
Doing nothing.
Just...
Staring.
: Please watch over her.
And then she leaves.
: Please watch over me, Sensei.
: I keep getting into trouble and need someone like you to bail me out.
: You know she was just looking out for you, right?
: You know she’s just obligated to do that since she’s the older sister, right?
: It’s her job to make sure I don’t talk about fucking my future teacher in public and it’s my job to sneak into her closet and cut her dresses into pieces.
: I really hope that’s not a thing you do to her.
: Not anymore, it’s not. Being grounded for two months was not a good time.
: But that’s beside the point~
Kirin grabs me by the tie and pulls me away from the entrance of the[school].
People can obviously still see us, just...less people, I guess.
: Be more excited about this or I’ll feel dumb for being excited myself.
: Who said I’m not excited?
: Are you?
: Sure.
: That doesn’t sound very convincing.
: Do you want me to jump up and down and shout “Yipee?”
: No. That would make me feel really uncomfortable now that I’m picturing it.
: Please stop picturing it.
: Ew. It’s actually kind of gross.
: Why my class, though?
: The fact that you need to ask is actually very upsetting.
: I mean, I get why you’d want to be in my class...but I figured you'd also think something like “It’s less fun if it happens all the time.”
: You mean like, you think I’ll stop wanting to be around you if I’m around you all the time?
: Yeah. That.
: Holy shit. What if you’re right?
: I didn’t even think about that.
: For all I know, you could completely lose interest in me the second I’m easier to obtain.
: Stop understanding me all of a sudden!
: I’ve done it. I’ve uncovered part of Kirin Kanda.
: You’ve uncovered several parts of me before.
: But for some reason, this one is significantly more embarrassing than the others. And I didn’t even cum this time.
: This conversation would be very strange if you did.
: So now what?
: What do you mean now what? Is your transfer finalized?
: Probably. Maybe? I don’t know.
: Yes.
: Yes it is.
: I join your class on Wednesday.
: Is this the end of our relationship?
: Obviously not. You have to at least fuck me first.
: After that, we can figure something out.
: Doesn’t the fact that you’ll be allowed to skip whenever you want now kind of void the purpose of our deal in the-
: You will fuck me and you will like it!
: I hope!
: I don’t know. I could be horrible.
: I’m probably not, but there’s always a chance.
: I’ll do my best!
: Today’s been a weird day.
: I woke up late...then I had to ask for a transfer...and now you’ve got me questioning my own feelings about-
: Oh my god. Are you hard?
: That “You will fuck me and you will like it” line got to me.
: Yeah...I can see that.
: Okay, so, being around you more than normal might be less of an issue than we think.
: I figured that out when you accidentally mentioned asking for a transfer.
: Did I actually say that?
: Right before noticing my erection.
: Huh.
: It’s still there.
: I know it’s still there! But even I’m not crazy enough to jerk you off in the courtyard while everyone is still leaving[school]!
: You’re going to have to...stop having a hard-on!
: Right now.
: Wow.
: No one’s ever told me that before.
: Listen, you can do all the perverted stuff you want to me when I move into the dorms.
: But for now, I’ve gotta...go for a walk and take some time to think about...stuff that I need to think about.
: It’s not like me to actually go out of my way for something like this.
: What is like you exactly? Because I still have no idea.
: I don’t know. That’s a thing I have to think about as well.
: So, like...do you really visit everyone in their rooms? You do, right?
: That's not just a rumor?
: The dorms are like a second home for me. Just all of the doors are locked and I’d probably get in trouble if anyone important ever heard me say that.
: And when I move in, you’ll visit me too?
: There is a high likelihood of that happening.
: What if my roommate sucks?
: Even better.
: Not that kind of suck.
: Oh.
: I don’t know. I’ll figure something out.
: Doesn’t your current class have dorms, though?
: Technically, yes. But it’s in a different building and no one I really like is there...so I’ve just been staying with my parents.
: At least in your building, I’ll have Miku to chill with if you ever get bored of me.
: Or if I’m horrible at sex.
: You’re probably not.
: But there’s always a chance.
: Are you okay?
: I’m fine! Thank you for asking!
: I’m...gonna go now!
: Right...
: I’ll...see you next week, I guess!
: Are you going to apologize to your sister for yelling at her?
: Maybe!
: I don’t know!
: Probably!
: Ahh! Get out of my head!
Huh...
So Kirin Kanda is transferring into my class.
Is something like that really okay while students from the other[school] are still trickling in one by one?
Granted, my class is still on the smaller side, but...
I don’t know.
I just never thought Kirin would go to the effort of actually making a change that drastic.
She’s always just seemed to go with the flow or whatever the hip new term for being a modern drifter is.
Regardless, I’m sure she’ll...liven up the class in a multitude of ways.
If anything, at least I can count on things being slightly more interesting from now on.
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
